analysis.select_processed: Select a processed document to inspect extracted text.

summary.title: AI Summary
summary.notice: The summary uses extracted text only. Content quality and visual layout are reviewed separately below.
summary.analyze_first_help: Analyze a document before generating an AI summary.
summary.not_generated: AI summary has not been generated for this document.
content_review.title: Content Quality Review
content_review.notice: Uses extracted text to check spelling, punctuation, grammar, official style, logic and internal factual consistency. Possible OCR artifacts are reported separately; external facts and plagiarism are not checked.
content_review.analyze_first_help: Analyze a document before reviewing its content.
content_review.start: Choose a review depth and start the content quality review.
layout_review.title: Visual Layout Review
layout_review.notice: Selected PDF pages are rendered in memory and sent to the configured AI provider. With Gemini this is external processing and may include signatures, stamps or other visual personal data. The result is advisory under general RK document rules; authenticity is not verified.
layout_review.select_pdf: Select a PDF document to review its visual layout.
layout_review.start: Start an advisory visual review of selected PDF pages.
layout_review.pdf_only: Visual layout review is available only for PDF documents.
upload.title: Upload
upload.help: Drop a PDF here or choose one from disk. The file is stored locally and metadata is saved in PostgreSQL.
